delta: Four additions: exact adopted r1_client_freshness.py blob imported from sibling; new composition implementation/test/scope. No modified predecessor bytes. A source import into a new candidate, not a blanket adoption or merge of sibling histories.
mechanism: Construct and exclusively route public read API through exact FreshnessClient; trusted shared identity binding copied before use
Require four distinct provisioned client/transport/holder/witness keys before creating journal
Persist ISSUE before producing authenticated SNAPSHOT request and invoking untrusted bytes-carrier callback once
Validate outer response MAC/role/context and exact request digest/nonce before passing nested snapshot to FreshnessClient.accept
FreshnessClient separately authenticates holder snapshot and inner witness checkpoint, rejects pending state/regression/equivocation and persists ACCEPT before returning evidence
Any issue/encode/carrier/decode/accept failure terminally closes composition and client; no retry/reset/refill; journal replay retains adopted pending/floor semantics
guarantees: Three separate key-authentication layers compose with retained client-history floor. The endpoint replay set remains volatile; client journal ISSUE/ACCEPT persists according to its accepted trusted filesystem contract. Reopened outstanding ISSUE refuses continuation. Persisted ACCEPT survives ACK uncertainty. No runtime admission result is returned.
limitations: Untrusted bytes carrier is not a deployed or qualified socket/TLS/network. No timeout, cancellation, service availability, confidentiality or authenticated remote host
Source binding is a trusted label, not loaded-code measurement; unchanged FreshnessClient journal does not bind transport source label/key across clean reconfiguration
Client/holder/witness histories require trusted independently retained nonrollback storage; whole-journal rollback and copied-client challenge reuse remain undetected
Four local key roles are checked; separation from supervisor/other protocol keys remains provisioning responsibility. Symmetric MAC is not nonrepudiation or key-custody proof
Python ownership/private fields are not hostile-process isolation or direct-witness bypass prevention. Callback must not reenter wrapper; synchronous lock serializes calls
No global enrollment, persistent server replay, distributed clone/fork fencing, complete VM provenance/lifetime/hidden-input closure, derivative toolchain, canonical manifest or admission acceptance
qualification: 24 new deterministic excluded synthetic methods, local first attempt PASS. Positive three-layer auth and recovered holder progress; independently invalid outer/holder/witness MAC; nested nonce/identity substitution; regression/equivocation/pending; durable ISSUE ordering; no retry after exchange/reply loss; ISSUE/ACCEPT fsync uncertainty; modeled missing trailing ACCEPT leaves ISSUE blocking; key alias/binding/source; no holder/witness writes; serialized concurrent distinct requests. Unchanged predecessor suites not rerun.
gate: Independent Reviewer B exact-composition review then separate orchestrator adoption; no official seeds/entropy/allocations/claims/markers/gameplay/outcomes/sealed worker/R1.
